method: Fresh-character balancing after disjoint tensor amplification; exact U/G/B/M transformation ledger and sublinear-terminal limit.
prior_status: General exact SMR reduction proved, but the sharp pair c=2, eta=1/4 was independently refuted; no replacement absolute pair known.
mathematical_delta: Proved that universal SMR is equivalent to balanced-only SMR even when the balanced estimate has an arbitrary o(N) additive terminal. The fresh-character lift preserves U,G,B,M exactly and adds one to I; tensor amplification deletes both balancing cost and every sublinear terminal. The independently certified five-bit witness yields a balanced positive-density counterfamily to c=2, eta=1/4 and forces c>=2.067158948727793 at eta=1/4 within this route.
remaining_obstacle: No absolute c, eta and sublinear terminal are proved for balanced Boolean spectra. The signed aggregate mismatch still lacks a dimension-independent payment.
next_action: On balanced spectra (p_empty=0), derive a cone-transport bound for M+(1+eta)U with an O(log N) or other o(N) terminal; test first on yF^{tensor t}, where F is the certified activation witness.
